improvements: The native caller explicitly supplies the reviewed engine identity to publication. A missing or cross-engine output identity is rejected before destination storage access.

Static analysis resolves only pure string-return helpers whose raise-only guards can be proven passed. It rejects unknown, mutable, recursive and arbitrary-call paths without executing application code.
Both dedicated pages declare the primary engine already used by their renderer. Generated source contracts now trace the actual current write path and expose its complete packet inspection.
Legacy history candidates and unresolved dynamic families remain partial and runtime-unverified. Source ownership does not authorize a model, investment call or position size.
A genuine pre-edit synthetic retained run reproduces with current reviewed code and exact predecessor storage bytes. No archived code is executed.

source_scope.scope: Static AST comparison only; no archived code executed.

importer_closure.scope: Read-only static current source package-closure analysis. No handlers, network, providers, native functions or archived code executed.

contract_counts.claim: Every field and row in an opened artifact or observed contracted API response is inspectable. Valid/partial counts are static access contracts, not runtime completeness certification; unindexed families, private paths, unknown writers and availability remain explicit.

isolated_browser_qa.scope: Real page, renderer and inspector with synthetic current/run/output fixtures; production and external navigation blocked; no production packet requests.

limitations: Both exact native packages, resources/schedules and served static assets remain pending. Normal scheduled publication is separately unverified.
Primary access remains partial: each page has three unresolved writes and three unindexed families. The legacy history writer remains unproven.
